catalog.name: Land Cover & Agriculture
catalog.description: Comprehensive land cover classification, agricultural land mapping, and surface albedo datasets from satellite observations providing essential information for land use monitoring, agricultural assessment, climate studies, and environmental management. These products enable understanding of terrestrial surface characteristics and their changes over time.

info.name: Attribution
info.content: Land cover data from NASA MODIS Combined missions and agricultural land datasets from multiple agencies. Surface albedo from MODIS Combined Terra/Aqua missions and MERRA-2 reanalysis. Processing by NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center (LP DAAC) and Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO). Contact: earthdata-support@nasa.gov

info.name: License
info.content: NASA data is generally available for public use. These products support land use planning, agricultural monitoring, climate research, and environmental management applications.

info.name: Agricultural Applications
info.content: Essential for crop area estimation, agricultural productivity assessment, irrigation planning, food security analysis, and precision agriculture applications.

info.name: Environmental Applications
info.content: Critical for land use change detection, deforestation monitoring, urban expansion tracking, ecosystem classification, and environmental impact assessment.

info.name: Climate Applications
info.content: Surface albedo and land cover data are fundamental for climate modeling, energy balance studies, and understanding land-atmosphere interactions.

members.name: Global Agricultural Lands
members.description: Global agricultural land datasets providing comprehensive mapping of croplands and agricultural areas for food security assessment and agricultural planning applications.

members.name: Global Croplands Distribution (2000)
members.description: Global distribution of croplands circa 2000 providing baseline agricultural land mapping for food security assessment, agricultural planning, and land use change analysis.

info.name: Background
info.content: This global croplands dataset provides comprehensive mapping of agricultural areas worldwide as of the year 2000, serving as a critical baseline for understanding global food production capacity and agricultural land distribution.

info.name: Spatial Coverage
info.content: Global coverage at high spatial resolution enabling identification of agricultural areas from continental to regional scales

info.name: Temporal Baseline
info.content: Year 2000 baseline providing reference period for agricultural land change detection and trend analysis over the past two decades

info.name: Classification Method
info.content: Uses satellite imagery analysis combined with agricultural census data and ground truth information to identify and map cropland areas

info.name: Agricultural Planning
info.content: Essential for understanding global agricultural capacity, identifying potential expansion areas, and assessing food security implications

info.name: Food Security Applications
info.content: Critical for global food security assessment, crop production estimation, and agricultural development planning in food-insecure regions

info.name: Land Use Change
info.content: Provides baseline for detecting agricultural expansion, conversion of natural areas to croplands, and urbanization impacts on agricultural land

info.name: Policy Applications
info.content: Supports agricultural policy development, sustainable agriculture planning, land tenure analysis, and rural development programs

info.name: Research Applications
info.content: Foundation for agricultural productivity research, climate change impact studies, biodiversity conservation planning, and land system modeling

info.name: Attribution
info.content: Multiple agency collaboration including NASA, USGS, and international agricultural organizations, global cropland mapping consortium

members.name: Land Cover Classification
members.description: Comprehensive land cover classification systems providing detailed ecosystem and land use type mapping from satellite observations for environmental monitoring and management.

members.name: IGBP Global Land Cover (Annual)
members.description: Annual global land cover classification using the International Geosphere-Biosphere Programme (IGBP) system providing comprehensive ecosystem mapping for environmental monitoring and climate studies.

info.name: Background
info.content: The IGBP (International Geosphere-Biosphere Programme) land cover classification system provides standardized global mapping of terrestrial ecosystems and land use types based on MODIS satellite observations.

info.name: Classification System
info.content: Uses 17 IGBP land cover classes including forests, grasslands, croplands, urban areas, water bodies, and barren land, providing comprehensive terrestrial ecosystem characterization

info.name: IGBP Land Cover Classes
info.content: Evergreen needleleaf forest, evergreen broadleaf forest, deciduous needleleaf forest, deciduous broadleaf forest, mixed forests, closed shrublands, open shrublands, woody savannas, savannas, grasslands, permanent wetlands, croplands, urban areas, cropland/natural vegetation mosaic, snow/ice, barren/sparsely vegetated, water bodies

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 500m spatial resolution providing detailed land cover mapping suitable for regional to global environmental studies

info.name: Annual Updates
info.content: Annual land cover maps enable tracking of ecosystem changes, deforestation, agricultural expansion, and urban growth over time

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: 2001 to present, providing over 20 years of consistent global land cover mapping for change detection and trend analysis

info.name: Environmental Monitoring
info.content: Essential for biodiversity conservation planning, ecosystem service assessment, habitat mapping, and environmental impact evaluation

info.name: Climate Applications
info.content: Critical input for climate models, carbon cycle studies, land-atmosphere interaction research, and climate change impact assessment

info.name: Conservation Applications
info.content: Supports protected area planning, ecosystem conservation strategies, wildlife habitat assessment, and biodiversity monitoring programs

info.name: Research Applications
info.content: Foundation for ecological research, land system science, environmental change studies, and sustainable development planning

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS Combined Terra/Aqua missions, Boston University land cover algorithm team, NASA Land Processes DAAC

members.name: Surface Albedo
members.description: Surface albedo measurements representing the fraction of solar radiation reflected by Earth's surface, critical for energy balance studies, climate modeling, and understanding land-atmosphere interactions.

members.name: Black Sky Albedo (Daily)
members.description: Daily black sky albedo from combined MODIS Terra and Aqua satellites representing surface reflectance under direct illumination conditions, essential for energy balance studies and climate modeling.

info.name: Background
info.content: Black sky albedo represents the directional-hemispherical reflectance of Earth's surface under direct beam illumination (no diffuse skylight), providing fundamental information about surface energy balance and solar radiation reflection.

info.name: Physical Significance
info.content: Measures the fraction of direct solar radiation reflected by the surface, critical for understanding surface energy budgets and heating rates

info.name: Illumination Conditions
info.content: Calculated for direct beam illumination conditions (black sky), representing surface reflectance when solar radiation comes primarily from the sun's direct beam

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 500m spatial resolution enabling detailed analysis of surface reflectance patterns across different land cover types and geographic regions

info.name: Temporal Resolution
info.content: Daily global coverage from combined Terra and Aqua MODIS observations providing high temporal resolution for monitoring albedo changes

info.name: Surface Type Variations
info.content: Varies significantly across land cover types: snow/ice (high ~0.8), forests (low ~0.1), grasslands (moderate ~0.2), deserts (variable ~0.3), crops (seasonal variation)

info.name: Climate Applications
info.content: Essential for climate models, surface energy balance calculations, land-atmosphere coupling studies, and understanding climate feedbacks

info.name: Energy Balance Studies
info.content: Critical for calculating net radiation, surface heating rates, and understanding regional energy budgets and temperature patterns

info.name: Environmental Applications
info.content: Supports urban heat island studies, agricultural monitoring, snow/ice monitoring, and land use change impact assessment

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS Combined Terra/Aqua missions, surface albedo algorithm development team, NASA Land Processes DAAC

members.name: White Sky Albedo (Daily)
members.description: Daily white sky albedo from combined MODIS Terra and Aqua satellites representing surface reflectance under diffuse illumination conditions, complementing black sky albedo for comprehensive surface energy analysis.

info.name: Background
info.content: White sky albedo represents the bi-hemispherical reflectance of Earth's surface under completely diffuse illumination conditions (isotropic skylight), providing complementary information to black sky albedo for surface energy studies.

info.name: Physical Significance
info.content: Measures surface reflectance when incoming solar radiation is completely diffuse, as occurs under overcast sky conditions or in heavily atmospheric conditions

info.name: Illumination Conditions
info.content: Calculated for diffuse illumination conditions (white sky), representing surface reflectance when solar radiation comes from all directions equally

info.name: Complementary to Black Sky
info.content: Combined with black sky albedo to calculate actual surface albedo under varying atmospheric conditions and sun angles

info.name: Atmospheric Interactions
info.content: Particularly relevant for understanding surface reflectance under cloudy conditions, high aerosol loading, and atmospheric scattering scenarios

info.name: Surface Energy Balance
info.content: Essential for accurate calculation of surface energy budgets under varying atmospheric and illumination conditions

info.name: Climate Model Applications
info.content: Critical input for climate models that need to account for varying atmospheric conditions and diffuse radiation components

info.name: Radiative Transfer Studies
info.content: Important for radiative transfer modeling, atmospheric correction algorithms, and understanding land-atmosphere radiation interactions

info.name: Research Applications
info.content: Advanced climate research, surface energy balance validation, atmospheric correction development, radiative transfer modeling

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MODIS Combined Terra/Aqua missions, surface albedo algorithm development team, NASA Land Processes DAAC

members.name: MERRA-2 Surface Albedo (Monthly)
members.description: Monthly surface albedo from MERRA-2 reanalysis providing model-based surface reflectance estimates that integrate observations with atmospheric models for comprehensive climate and weather analysis.

info.name: Background
info.content: MERRA-2 surface albedo provides model-based estimates of surface reflectance by integrating satellite observations with advanced atmospheric models, offering consistent global surface albedo for climate and weather applications.

info.name: Reanalysis Integration
info.content: Combines satellite observations with atmospheric modeling using data assimilation techniques to provide physically consistent surface albedo estimates

info.name: Model Consistency
info.content: Provides surface albedo that is consistent with other atmospheric variables in the MERRA-2 system, ensuring energy balance closure and physical consistency

info.name: Gap Filling
info.content: Fills gaps in satellite-based albedo products due to cloud cover, polar darkness, and instrument limitations using model physics

info.name: Temporal Consistency
info.content: Maintains temporal consistency throughout the reanalysis period (1980-present), important for long-term climate studies and trend analysis

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 0.5° × 0.625° global grid suitable for climate model validation and large-scale energy balance studies

info.name: Climate Applications
info.content: Essential for climate model evaluation, long-term climate trend analysis, and understanding surface energy balance variability

info.name: Weather Applications
info.content: Supports numerical weather prediction model development, surface energy flux analysis, and meteorological research

info.name: Validation Applications
info.content: Used for validating satellite-based albedo products, climate model surface schemes, and land surface model components

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA MERRA-2 reanalysis, NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO), surface albedo modeling team
